source.title: Irish News, 6 June 1958, p. 1 ("County and rural council elections"); Banbridge Chronicle, 13 June 1958, p. 4 ("Notice of result of elections: Rural District of Banbridge, election of rural district councillors, 1958 (dated 5 June 1958)")
source.publisher: Irish News (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: Votes as printed; 176-130=46. Votes agree with the returning officer's notice of result (page image read: Murray 176, McCauley 130).

note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors, polled Thursday 5 June 1958. Two contests, Magherally and Ballybrick (Belfast News-Letter, 6 June 1958, p. 5; Irish News, 6 June 1958, p. 1). The other eighteen divisions are from the returning officer's notice of result (Banbridge Chronicle, 13 June 1958, p. 4): fourteen members returned unopposed and, with no nomination for Gilford, Loughbrickland, Scarva and Tullylish, their retiring members deemed to be re-elected (round 2, 7 Nov 2026).
